sources.title: Synodic-AI · Your data. Your models. Your rules.
sources.snippet: Sovereign AI · Healthcare · Government · Regulated enterprise Your data. Your models. Your rules. Data is the currency of today, and it moves through systems never built to protect it. The Synodic suite governs closed AI end to end: your models, your data, and your people, under rules you set. Nothing enters or leaves unless you intend it to.
